question: What would come in place of 5?
solution:
The correct answer is '**t****ouches'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Contacts
 the fact of two people or things touching each other
 
 

 Separates
 existing or happening independently or in a different physical space
 
 

 **Touches**
 **to put your hand or another part of your body lightly onto and off something or someone**
 
 

 Isolates
 to separate something from other things with which it is connected or mixed
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that** the touch of an infectious person can contaminate the environment.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, **the most appropriate word to fill the blank is ‘t****ouches'.**
 
• Another example:
 
 
• *​My brother told me not to** touch** his computer.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the** correct answer is Option 3.**

** **

Correct Sentence:__ *...when an infectious person__** touches**__ clothing, bedding, towels, objects...*
